bio: Son of Henry Tuthill (b. 1690) and grandson of Justice Henry Tuthill (1665-1750). Married 16 Mar 1738 Phoebe Horton (a descendant of Barnabas Horton through three Calebs). Father of Anna Tuthill, wife of Judge John Cleves Symmes and mother of First Lady Anna Symmes Harrison. Akerly says outright that Henry's granddaughter Anna Symmes married President W. H. Harrison.
sources: [R4-S1] Lucy D. Akerly, The Tuthill Family of Tharston, Norfolk Co., England, and Southold, Suffolk Co., New York (1898) (archive.org full text), pp. 8-10 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/tuthillfamilyoft00aker
